primitives.name: Intent settlement pallet
primitives.desc: Batched intent settlement on Materios: submit, match and atomically settle signed trading intents with bonded execution.

primitives.name: Perp engine pallet
primitives.desc: Perpetual-futures engine: position accounting, funding, margin and liquidation over the settlement layer.

primitives.name: Intent-settlement oracle pallet
primitives.desc: Threshold price oracle feeding marks and settlement prices to the perp engine, with staleness and deviation guards.

primitives.name: Committee governance pallet
primitives.desc: Governance over the settlement committee: membership, thresholds and parameter changes under a root-gated origin.

primitives.name: Settlement keeper
primitives.desc: Off-chain keeper that watches for matchable intents and liquidatable positions and submits the settling extrinsics.

primitives.name: Intent settlement SDK
primitives.desc: TypeScript client for building, signing and submitting settlement intents.
